critical_methodological_limitations: Sample size of subjects is N=2, precluding population-level variance estimation.
Single-subject training: each fold learns exclusively from one individual's anatomical and drug profile.
Record 106 (24 F, Inderal, multiform PVCs) and Record 119 (51 F, Pronestyl, uniform PVCs) exhibit strong inter-subject domain shift.
Ordinary 5-fold beat-level CV causes intra-patient leakage and MUST NOT be cited as evidence of patient generalization.
Test records (200, 208) remain strictly isolated and never participate in model selection.

scaler_clipping_audit.scientific_conclusion: Clipping events occur due to inter-patient anatomical variability. Clipping does NOT preserve zero information loss; it saturates out-of-distribution points at boundary rotational angles (0 or pi).

qrs_rms_audit.window_specification: [-25, +25] samples around annotated R-peak (sample 144), spanning 51 samples (~141.7 ms at 360 Hz)
qrs_rms_audit.baseline_correction_method: Median subtraction of the 51-sample ROI prior to RMS calculation
qrs_rms_audit.scientific_rationale: Uncorrected RMS includes non-cardiac DC baseline wander squared: RMS^2 = RMS_true^2 + DC^2 + 2*DC*mean. Baseline-corrected RMS isolates genuine morphological depolarization energy.

qrs_duration_audit.search_window: [-36, +36] samples around R-peak (sample 144), total 73 samples (~202.8 ms at 360 Hz)
qrs_duration_audit.threshold_criterion: 20% of peak envelope amplitude above local median baseline
qrs_duration_audit.limitation_note: Single-lead thresholding provides an estimated QRS duration (w_QRS_est). In 24 beats (8%), the envelope maximum was offset >3 samples from the annotation. This feature is designated an estimate unless validated against 12-lead cardiologist calipers.

spectral_estimation_audit.rayleigh_resolution_note: Zero-padding to n=720 interpolates DTFT samples (0.5 Hz bin spacing) but does NOT increase physical frequency resolution, which is fundamentally bounded by T = 1.0 s (df = 1/T = 1.0 Hz).
spectral_estimation_audit.scientific_recommendation: Rectangular FFT is prone to low-frequency leakage from baseline wander into broadband denominator. Linear detrending + Hann tapering suppresses sidelobe leakage to -31 dB.

real_time_operational_constraint.lookahead_requirement: Post-RR interval requires detection of subsequent R-peak (R_{i+1})
real_time_operational_constraint.operational_conclusion: The classifier cannot trigger an instantaneous alarm at the moment of R-peak R_i. It operates with a physiological latency of ~0.75 s for sinus beats and ~1.05 s for VEBs. Post-RR is retained per protocol but explicitly documented as an offline/retrospective feature.
